channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: From intelligence to authority: Alibaba's Qwen and strategic arrival of agentic AI
item.description: The significance of Alibaba's upgraded Qwen AI lies not in novelty, but in finality. It marks the end of AI as a passive assistant and the beginning of AI as an active participant in economic and institutional life.

item.title: Rajpal Yadav out of jail: Delhi HC grants actor interim bail after he deposits Rs 1.5 crore in cheque bounce case
item.description: Bollywood actor Rajpal Yadav has been granted interim bail by the Delhi High Court until March 18 in his Rs 9 crore cheque bounce case. The actor is set to be released from Tihar Jail today and will soon hold a press conference to present his side of the story.

item.title: AI will bring shift in terms of jobs but it is a huge opportunity too: Wipro's Hari Shetty
item.description: Hari Shetty of Wipro Limited said AI will reshape jobs but create major opportunities. Citing the World Economic Forum, he noted AI could generate 170 million jobs while disrupting 92 million.

item.title: India to import more precious metals from US
item.description: The pact is expected to boost sectors such as data centres by lowering duties on enterprise GPU servers and improve Indian exports through reduced or zero tariffs on billions of dollars' worth of goods, while safeguarding agriculture and MSMEs.

item.title: UIDAI records nearly 14 million downloads of new Aadhaar App​
item.description: UIDAI has recorded nearly 14 million downloads of its new Aadhaar App. Averaging over 100,000 daily downloads, the app offers services like mobile updates, biometric lock/unlock, e-Aadhaar downloads, and QR-based verification, promoting secure and user-friendly digital identity

item.title: Can't afford delay in using AI for inclusive growth, says CEA Nageswaran
item.description: CEA Nageswaran called for a "Team India" approach involving government, industry and academia, along with reforms in education and skill development. S. Krishnan emphasised that AI must remain human-centric and democratically accessible.

item.title: Rashmika Mandanna, Vijay Deverakonda to marry on February 26; reception in March, wedding invite leaked
item.description: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna are set to marry on February 26, with reports suggesting a destination wedding in Udaipur. The couple will host a reception in Hyderabad on March 4, as mentioned in a wedding invite circulating in the media, which states that celebrations will begin at 7 pm.

item.title: Ultimate Guide to Buying BLDC Ceiling Fans in 2026
item.description: The 2026 BLDC ceiling fan guide highlights how cloud-connected, energy-efficient, and whisper-quiet motors are revolutionizing home cooling while slashing electricity bills by up to 65%.

item.title: Indian stock markets trade lower, metals lead losses
item.description: As of 9.30 am, Sensex lost 232 points, or 0.28 per cent, to reach 83,044, and Nifty dipped 92 points, or 0.36 per cent, to settle at 25,590.

item.title: Fake online investment scam busted in J&K's Ganderbal, mastermind arrested from Delhi
item.description: The accused operated fake investment and coin-trading platforms, luring victims with promises of high returns and routing funds through hundreds of bank accounts before transferring the money outside the region.
